newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse turnover this year exceeds '96 level.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse turnover this year exceeds '96 level.

text.p: Total turnover on the Lisbon bourse so far this year has exceeded the turnover achieved in the whole of 1996, bourse officials said.
They said that total turnover to date this year was 3.409 trillion escudos in volume of 700 million shares, compared with 3.389 trillion escudos in 1996 in volume of 868 million shares.

One contributing factor for the increase in turnover was that last month the Portuguese government privatised a 30 percent stake in utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, which is the biggest stock on Lisbon bourse.
